customer.schema:
c_custkey: int32 not null
c_nationkey: int32 not null

lineitem.schema:
l_orderkey: int32 not null
l_suppkey: int32 not null
l_extendedprice: decimal128(15, 2) not null
l_discount: decimal128(15, 2) not null

nation.schema:
n_nationkey: int32 not null
n_name: dictionary<values=string, indices=int32, ordered=0> not null
n_regionkey: int32 not null

orders.schema:
o_orderkey: int32 not null
o_custkey: int32 not null
o_orderdate: date32[day] not null

region.schema:
r_regionkey: int32 not null
r_name: dictionary<values=string, indices=int32, ordered=0> not null

supplier.schema:
s_suppkey: int32 not null
s_nationkey: int32 not null
